summary: {senator} draws on a child's years of hearing-aid fittings to explain a reservation about adult retail sales.
realLife: Mike Enzi recalled his daughter's hearing aids and the expertise her fittings took while questioning the effect of the adult provision on patients' ties to professionals.
inGame: needs: family ties, device history and the age group a bill covers.

turns.pulledBy: A colleague asks whose fittings the speaker remembers.
turns.what: The speaker distinguishes a child's needs from an adult shopper's choices.
turns.writesBack: The member explains the family experience and identifies the age group covered by the bill.

turns.pulledBy: A family declines to be identified in the debate.
turns.what: The family member asks for privacy.
turns.writesBack: The speaker describes the role of a fitter without identifying the patient.
